lastCompletedStory.title: Emit the cycle-metrics row automatically at cycle close

nextStoryContext: US-004 wired the US-003 writer (upsertCycleMetricsRowOnMain, src/commands/cycle-metrics.ts) into dispatchJournal (index.ts): a new optional JournalDispatchDeps.cycleMetricsAppendFn (default: defaultCycleMetricsAppendFn, reading .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl via readFileSync + a real spawnSync, mirroring defaultArchiveFn/defaultPatternsArchiveFn) is called UNCONDITIONALLY on every successful `cam journal append` -- not gated on --cycle-close, because recordCycleTokens itself is unconditional and no cycle-tokens marker may exist without a matching cycle-metrics row. Call site sits immediately after recordFn() and strictly before the `if (parsed.cycleClose)` block (so strictly before archiveFn/patternsArchiveFn/armRecycleMarkerFn), wrapped in try/catch, best-effort (a throw or ok:false only printWarning's, never changes the exit code, the recycle marker, or CAM_ORCH_HANDOFF_DUE). JOURNAL_HELP's Behaviour body got a new non-restructuring paragraph documenting this (per the CAM-217 silently-undocumented-behaviour scar) between the exit-code contract and the `cam journal archive` section. With this story, the full cycle-metrics pipeline (US-001 pure aggregation, US-002 CLI --rebuild reporter, US-003 on-main writer, US-004 automatic emission) is complete: `scripts/cam/cycle-metrics.jsonl` now grows automatically at every cycle close with zero manual step. GOTCHA for any FUTURE story that makes another dispatchJournal dep unconditional: making cycleMetricsAppendFn unconditional (rather than --cycle-close-gated like archiveFn/patternsArchiveFn) required injecting a hermetic fake into 19 pre-existing dispatchJournal(...) test call sites across two files (test/commands/journal-append.test.ts, test/commands/patterns-cli.test.ts) that previously didn't need one -- see the new patterns.md bullet (CAM-470) for the full blast-radius accounting and the two reusable fake shapes (noopCycleMetricsFn / inline order-tracking fakes).
